title: Settlement Names
description: A HelloBiome addon that generates unique fantasy names for villages and displays them using a fully customizable animated location overlay. Special thanks to Aquarius.playz for permission to create and publish this addon.
body:
# Settlement Names

**Settlement Names** is an addon for HelloBiome that brings unique identities to Minecraft villages through procedurally generated settlement names and highly customizable location display animations.

As you explore the world, villages are automatically detected and assigned a unique biome-themed fantasy name. Every settlement keeps its identity permanently, creating a more immersive and memorable exploration experience.

## Features

### Unique Settlement Names

* Automatically detects all vanilla village variants:

  * Plains
  * Desert
  * Savanna
  * Snowy
  * Taiga
 
* Generates unique fantasy names based on the village biome.
* Names are generated only once and permanently saved to the world.
* Fully multiplayer compatible.
* Server-to-client synchronization for seamless gameplay.

### Advanced Location Overlay

* Displays settlement names when entering a village.
* Inspired by the HelloBiome location display system.
* Fully customizable fade-in, display, and fade-out animations.
* Configurable colors, durations, and movement directions.
* Five animation easing modes:

  * Smooth
  * Linear
  * Bounce
  * Overshoot
  * Elastic

* Scale animations.
* Rotation animations.
* Optional shake effect with damping.
* Typewriter text animation.
* Automatic font scaling for long names.
* Optional text shadows.
* Multiple text alignment options:

  * Center
  * Left
  * Right
  
* Settlement name blacklist support.
* Configurable display cooldown.

### In-Game Configuration

* Integrated settings screen accessible through HelloBiome.
* All settings can be adjusted in-game.
* Changes are automatically saved to the configuration file.

### Custom Name Packs

* Separate name lists for each village biome category.
* Stored in `settlement_names.properties`.
* Fully customizable without restarting Minecraft.

## Requirements

### Required Dependencies

* Fabric Loader 0.16.0+
* Fabric API
* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Java 21+
* HelloBiome

HelloBiome is required for Settlement Names, as this mod is designed as an addon and extends HelloBiome's location display experience.

Get HelloBiome here:
https://modrinth.com/mod/hello-biome

## Credits

### HelloBiome

Special thanks to **Aquarius.playz**, creator of HelloBiome, for granting permission to develop and publish this addon.

Settlement Names would not exist without the foundation and inspiration provided by HelloBiome.

### Responsibility

While Settlement Names is built as an addon for HelloBiome, all development, maintenance, support, and responsibility for this addon belong solely to the Settlement Names project and its author.

## Server-Side Naming System

Settlement Names uses a lightweight server-side system that:

* Detects villages automatically.
* Generates names only once per settlement.
* Stores all settlement names permanently in the world save.
* Synchronizes names to players when entering or leaving villages.

Every village deserves its own identity. Explore the world, discover new settlements, and uncover the stories hidden behind their names.
